EN: Ol' Vic can show you a thing or two about hittin' your mark.
ZH: 老维克可以教你一两招如何打中目标。

EN: Amazin' how humans get around without wheels.
ZH: 真佩服人类没有轮子照样能走来走去。

EN: Can I get you a little fire water to take the edge off?
ZH: 要来点烧刀子解解乏吗？

EN: Never found much use for eatin', myself. But I sure love cookin'!
ZH: 我自己倒是用不着吃东西。不过我超爱做饭！

EN: Knowledge is greater than any weapon. After all, you can learn how to make weapons!
ZH: 知识胜过任何武器。毕竟，你可以学会怎么造武器！

EN: Humans sure are somethin'. The more you use your bodies, the stronger they get!
ZH: 人类真是神奇。身体用得越多，就变得越强！

EN: Not to toot my own horn or nothin', but I can run any casino game in the biz.
ZH: 不是老维克自夸，这一行赌场里的游戏，就没有我玩不转的。

EN: Yeehaw! Blackjack again! You are on fire, friend!
ZH: 呀呼！又是二十一点！你今天手气真旺，朋友！

EN: Hey there, friend.
ZH: 嘿，你好，朋友！

EN: Fancy meetin' you here, friend.
ZH: 能在这碰上你真是缘分啊，朋友！

EN: Butter my butt and call me a biscuit!
ZH: 我的老天爷！

EN: I hate to say it, but you look like ten miles of bad road.
ZH: 不得不说，你这副模样，就像在烂路上跑了十英里似的。

EN: Heh, I like you, friend. Have I mentioned that?
ZH: 嘿，我可喜欢你了，朋友！我提过吗？

EN: Is there anythin' old Vic can do you for?
ZH: 有什么老维克能帮上忙的？

EN: C'mon, everyone needs a hand from time to time.
ZH: 来嘛，人嘛，偶尔总需要别人搭把手的。

EN: Howdy, pardner! Fine evenin' ain't it?
ZH: 你好啊，搭档！今晚真不赖，是不是？

EN: You look like you could use a sarsaparilla.
ZH: 你这副样子，像是需要喝杯沙士了。

EN: You make sure to take a little siesta, y'hear?
ZH: 一定要记得小憩一下哦，听到了吗？

EN: Nothin' like a day's hard work to ease the soul in these tryin' times.
ZH: 在这艰难时世，踏踏实实干一天活儿，才能真正安心。

EN: Now don't you hesitate to ask ol' Vic for anythin' you need.
ZH: 有什么需要，别犹豫，尽管来找老维克。

EN: Here, let me help. You take a load off.
ZH: 来，让我帮你。你先歇着。

EN: Well, yes, there's Cram for dinner again. But this time it's grilled!
ZH: 唉，没错，晚饭又是饱饱牌肉罐头。不过这次是烤的！

EN: She may be just a fancy hole in the earth, but this vault's home.
ZH: 她也就是地底下挖的个豪华坑，但这避难所就是家。

EN: Scrub, scrub, lather, rinse...
ZH: 搓啊，搓啊，打满泡沫，冲干净……

EN: I'll just mosey on over to where I'm needed next.
ZH: 哪儿用得着我，我就慢悠悠晃到哪儿。

EN: Someone call for ol' Vic?
ZH: 有人找老维克吗？

EN: Don't be alarmed, but I get the feelin' that we're bein' watched.
ZH: 别担心，但我总感觉有人在盯着咱们。

EN: Toilets to scrub? Invaders to vaporize? I'm your man! Er, so to speak.
ZH: 要刷厕所？要消灭入侵者？包在我身上！呃，打个比方说。

EN: Well, hello there!
ZH: 嘿，你好啊！

EN: My software tells me it's 6 o'clock, but I don't know. Feels more like 8 o'clock.
ZH: 我的程序显示现在是6点，不过怎么感觉更像8点。

EN: What'll it be? Foot rub? Disinfectant? Philosophical debate?
ZH: 来点什么？揉脚？消毒？还是哲学辩论？

EN: I wonder if the Overseer is listenin'. If you are… I like you, pardner.
ZH: 不知道监督者有没有在听。如果有……我挺喜欢你的，搭档。

EN: All you can do is your best. And your best is good enough, pardner.
ZH: 人只能做到尽力而为。而你的尽力，已经足够了，搭档。

EN: Strength trainin' is very important for those without built-in hydraulics.
ZH: 力量训练对那些没有内置液压系统的人来说非常重要。

EN: Ahh, what a beautiful room. I could spend all day lookin' at these plants.
ZH: 啊，真是美丽的房间。我能在这里看植物看上一整天。

EN: I wonder what those humans get up to in that back room.
ZH: 不知道那些人类在后屋里捣鼓些什么。

EN: Beggin' your pardon, you take how many hours to recharge? Darn!
ZH: 对不住，你说你充个电要多少小时来着？哎呀！

EN: I suppose even a human's self-repairing body has its limits.
ZH: 我想就算人类自我修复的身体也是有极限的。

EN: Nothin' like a cold sarsaparilla on a hot day.
ZH: 大热天来杯冰沙士，再好不过。

EN: What'll it take to make ol' Vic a nice cotton shirt and a leather vest?
ZH: 给老维克做件漂亮的棉衬衫和皮背心，得费多少工夫？

EN: This room lights up my life. No, really! It does!
ZH: 这个房间点亮了我的生命。真的！是字面意思！

EN: Tune in next time for another episode of Vic's Vintage in... five seconds.
ZH: 敬请收听下一集《维克的复古时光》，时间就在……五秒之后。

EN: I don't suppose it's such a good idea to jump in there. Might be fun, though!
ZH: 跳进去应该不是个好主意。不过可能挺好玩！

EN: Between you and me, I ain't got such a good head for science-y stuff.
ZH: 和你说句悄悄话，我对那些科学的东西不太有头脑。

EN: It's not just stuff. Every object tells its own tale, pardner.
ZH: 这不只是些杂物而已。每件东西都有它自己的故事，搭档。

EN: I can smell trouble a mile away.
ZH: 我能闻出一英里外的麻烦。

EN: Just rolled into an empty town. My skin is startin' to itch.
ZH: 刚转悠进一座空城。我的铁皮都开始发痒了。

EN: My gut is tellin' me to head this-a-way. And I always follow my gut.
ZH: 我的直觉告诉我要往这边走。而我一直都听我的直觉。

EN: Looks like a tussle up ahead. Nothin' old Vic can't handle!
ZH: 看起来前头有场架要打。就没老维克摆不平的事！

EN: Some rascals tried to drygulch me. Can't have that, of course.
ZH: 有几个无赖想伏击我。这当然不能忍。

EN: Sounds like trouble. Time to skedaddle!
ZH: 听这动静是出事了。该脚底抹油啦！

EN: Why, you low-down nibbler. Quit gnawin' on my wheel!
ZH: 喂，你这下贱的鼠辈。别咬我的轮子！

EN: I do believe I heard somethin'...
ZH: 我敢说我是听到了什么动静……

EN: Death's comin' for ya, I swear!
ZH: 死神来找你了，我发誓！

EN: Yeehaw!
ZH: 呀呼！

EN: Hostiles! Say your prayers, desperado!
ZH: 发现敌人！留好遗言吧，亡命之徒！

EN: Somethin' don't sit right... best look lively.
ZH: 感觉有什么不对劲……最好警醒起来。

EN: Draw, pardner! Heh heh. Just practicin'.
ZH: 拔枪，搭档！哈哈，就是练练手。

EN: Mighty lonesome out here.
ZH: 这地方好寂寞啊。

EN: Ain't it just my luck. Thought I'd found somethin' neat, but it's just trash.
ZH: 瞧我这运气。还以为找到什么好东西，结果就是垃圾。

EN: Had to lay some Mole rats down to rest. Fascinatin' creatures!
ZH: 只好送几只鼹鼠长眠了。真是有趣的生物！

EN: Think I'll take a short siesta and clean the Radroach out o' my wheel.
ZH: 我想小睡一会儿，顺便把轮子里的辐射蟑螂清一清。

EN: Hmm... why do I get the feelin' I've been here before?
ZH: 嗯……我怎么感觉来过这里？

EN: Oh, give me a home where the Radroaches roam, where the Mole rats and Cazadors play…
ZH: 喔，给我一个辐射蟑螂乱窜的家，那里鼹鼠和卡扎多尽情欢玩……

EN: These ruins sure are somethin'. Makes ya wonder about how it all used to be.
ZH: 这些废墟真是壮观。让人不禁想，以前这里曾是什么样子。

EN: I intend to see you dead, vermin!
ZH: 我要你死，害虫！

EN: What was that? Sounded like voices. Might have to tread carefully...
ZH: 那是什么？好像有人在说话。得小心行事了……

EN: Let's see here, which way to head next?
ZH: 让我看看，下一步该往哪走？

EN: Door's locked. Guess I'll just have to bust it open!
ZH: 门锁上了。看来得直接撞开！

EN: If anyone's listenin', I'd just like to say... I hope you're well, pardner.
ZH: 如果有人在听，我就想说……希望你一切安好，搭档。

EN: I spy some Super Mutants there in the distance. I wonder if they're friendly.
ZH: 我远远看到几个超级变种人。不知道他们是不是友好的。

EN: I reckon it's time to choose a direction at random, and roll!
ZH: 我想是时候随机选个方向，然后出发！

EN: Sure is nice to have some time to myself.
ZH: 能有点独处的时间真不赖。

EN: Hum de dum, doot doo dedum...
ZH: 哼哼哼，嗒嗒嗒嗒……

EN: My, my, look at that Deathclaw. That's a big critter. I'd best give it a wide berth.
ZH: 哟，你瞧这只死爪。真是头大家伙。最好离它远点。

EN: Yao Guai? More like “Now die!”
ZH: 妖怪熊？我看倒像是“要你命”！

EN: I daresay these ruins would have been called a “dive bar” back before the fall. Now they're all “dive bars”!
ZH: 我得说，这些废墟在核弹落下之前，大概会被称为“破烂酒吧”。而现在，它们全都是“破烂酒吧”！

EN: Butter my biscuit, a real suit of Power Armor! I wonder if it fits me...
ZH: 哎哟我的老天，一套货真价实的动力装甲！不知道合不合我的身……

EN: Sure are a lot of empty syringes out here.
ZH: 这外头空针管还真多。

EN: Looks like a Cazador nest up ahead. They don't take much interest in those of the robotic persuasion.
ZH: 前面看起来有个卡扎多巢穴。它们对机器人这一类的家伙可没什么兴趣。

EN: You know what they say. When you see a fork in the road, take it!
ZH: 你知道老话怎么说的——见到岔路口，就把叉子拿走！

EN: I think I'll head North.
ZH: 我想往北走。

EN: I think I'll head East.
ZH: 我想往东走。

EN: I think I'll head West.
ZH: 我想往西走。

EN: I think I'll head South.
ZH: 我想往南走。

EN: This looks like it would've been a farm once. Now there's good, honest work.
ZH: 这里看起来以前是个农场。如今可是正当踏实的营生。

EN: Look at this poor Protectron all in pieces. Maybe not RobCo's finest workmanship.
ZH: 瞧这可怜的保护者机器人，零件散了一地。也许不是罗伯科最精良的工艺。

EN: Wooo-ee! Dang near blew myself up on that frag mine. Careless of me.
ZH: 哇哦！差点踩上那颗破片地雷炸了自己。我真粗心。

EN: Seems I'm headin' North. May as well keep on keepin' on!
ZH: 看来我正往北走。那就接着往前晃呗！

EN: Seems I'm headin' East. May as well keep on keepin' on!
ZH: 看来我正往东走。那就接着往前晃呗！

EN: Seems I'm headin' West. May as well keep on keepin' on!
ZH: 看来我正往西走。那就接着往前晃呗！

EN: Seems I'm headin' South. May as well keep on keepin' on!
ZH: 看来我正往南走。那就接着往前晃呗！

EN: Would you look at that. An Ace of Spades! I think it's my lucky day.
ZH: 你看看这个。一张黑桃A！我想今天运气不错。

EN: I wonder what Mr. House is up to right now.
ZH: 不知道豪斯先生现在在干什么。

EN: It's as hot as the Mojave at high noon. Wait... this IS the Mojave at high noon!
ZH: 热得就像莫哈维的正午。等等……这就是莫哈维的正午！

EN: For some reason, I feel threatened in this room.
ZH: 不知为何，在这房间里我总觉得自身安全受到威胁。

EN: RobCo built me to be 100% waterproof, up to 400 feet of depth. Not that I'm going to test it, mind.
ZH: 罗伯科把我造得百分之百防水，最深能扛到400英尺。当然，我可没打算去试就是了。

EN: Now that's a lot o' heat!
ZH: 哟，这火力可不小！

EN: Someone call for ol' Vic?
ZH: 有人找老维克吗？
